content: Philippine POS systems implementing SC/PWD discounts (RA 9994, RR 7-2010, RMC 71-2022) must: capture ID number (OSCA/PWD ID) name and TIN; compute by removing 12% VAT first then applying 20% discount to the VAT-exclusive amount; print separate receipt lines 'Less: VAT Exemption' and 'Less: 20% SC/PWD Discount'; segregate exempt vs taxable sales in POS/CRM tape (reprogram if incapable); for group/restaurant meals apply the Most Expensive Meal Combo (MEMC) rule — discount basis is a per-head 'most expensive single serving meal' base value, with the total group discount capped to the number of qualifying seniors/PWDs actually present, enforced via a max-beneficiaries-vs-bill-total check in commercial POS software (e.g. StoreHub, Qashier).
